title: Jake Barber: 'Who is we?' and black money

tellings.quote: That was the most fascinating part of my Jake interview is he was like, "Who is we?" And I was like, "I don't know. I assume like the US or like whatever, you know, aerospace corporations you might be working for." And and and then he was like, "No, we don't have shit."

plain: When Michels interviewed a man named Jake Barber, who claims inside knowledge of UFO work, and assumed that "we" meant the US or the aerospace companies Barber might work for, Barber asked him "Who is we?" and then said, "No, we don't have shit." Michels recalls the exchange himself as the most fascinating part of that interview, alongside talk of secret, off-the-books funding. If taken at face value, it suggests that whoever holds the real secrets is not the US government or its contractors.
